issues.location: Throughout Proposal (Executive Summary, Understanding, Approach, Phases & Timeline, Pricing Approach)
issues.description: The proposal repeatedly references NetSuite as the accounting system, which is not stated in the Client Matrix.
issues.suggested_fix: Remove references to NetSuite or replace with generic accounting integration language until confirmed with the client.

issues.description: The proposal presents a rigid 16-week timeline as fact without explicitly acknowledging in this section the active disagreement between stakeholders regarding a Q3 vs Q4 pilot release target.
issues.suggested_fix: Frame the 16-week timeline as a baseline subject to stakeholder schedule alignment, referencing the open question on Q3 vs Q4 release dates.

issues.description: The proposal refers to the dispatch tool generically as 'Legacy Rails Dispatch App' rather than referencing 'Routemaster' by name as specified in the Client Matrix.
issues.suggested_fix: Explicitly reference Routemaster in the architectural overview and diagrams to demonstrate thorough understanding of the technical stack.

risks: Unverified technical assumptions like NetSuite integration could undermine vendor credibility with a CFO who is already skeptical of consultants.
Conflict between CTO and VP Ops/CFO regarding Q3 vs Q4 launch timelines could delay project initiation if not resolved prior to signing.
